title: Judges Bible Quiz - Chapter 4
description: Ten questions on Judges 4: Deborah, Barak and Jael bring the defeat of Sisera.

questions.text: Where did Jabin king of Canaan reign?
questions.explanation: Judges 4:2 says Jabin king of Canaan reigned in Hazor.

questions.text: Who was the captain of Jabin's army?
questions.explanation: Judges 4:2 says the captain of his army was Sisera, who lived in Harosheth of the Gentiles.

questions.text: How many chariots of iron did Jabin have?
questions.explanation: Judges 4:3 says he had nine hundred chariots of iron.

questions.text: Whose wife was Deborah the prophetess?
questions.explanation: Judges 4:4 calls Deborah a prophetess, the wife of Lappidoth.

questions.text: Where did Deborah live when Israel came to her for judgment?
questions.explanation: Judges 4:5 says she lived under Deborah's palm tree between Ramah and Bethel in the hill country of Ephraim.

answers.text: On the top of Mount Tabor

questions.text: To which mountain was Barak told to lead the way?
questions.explanation: In Judges 4:6 Deborah tells Barak to lead the way to Mount Tabor.

questions.text: What condition did Barak set before he would go?
questions.explanation: In Judges 4:8 Barak says, "If you will go with me, then I will go."

answers.text: That Deborah would go with him
That he would get twenty thousand men
That Yahweh would send a sign first
That Jabin would come out himself

questions.text: Into whose hand did Deborah say Yahweh would sell Sisera?
questions.explanation: Judges 4:9 says Yahweh will sell Sisera into a woman's hand.

questions.text: When Sisera asked Jael for a little water, what did she give him?
questions.explanation: Judges 4:19 says she opened a container of milk and gave him a drink.
Judges 4:21 says she struck a tent peg into his temples with a hammer while he was in a deep sleep.

answers.text: She struck a tent peg into his temples
She stabbed him with his own sword
She threw a millstone on his head
